The two hysteresis modes are where monitoring becomes logic. High-Hysteresis outputs above Param1 and only cancels below Param2; Low-Hysteresis mirrors it. Param1 and Param2 are typed directly — scientific notation like 1.5E6 works.

The classic build: a High-Hysteresis monitor watching wireless storage trips a steam valve at 90 percent and re-arms at 75 — no flicker, no chatter, no thrashed turbines. A long outage arms a 30 second redstone buffer so a chunk reload never false-trips the logic.

Build one hysteresis guard around your biggest consumer and report in.
